entry.name: Progressive word stack
entry.description: Progressive source-aligned words over video, with reserved row widths, optional word emphasis and brief lift/blur entry.
entry.origin: Generalized from our authored MIT motion-study recipes, inspired by the user-supplied FROM BILLIONS TO NOTHING OVERNIGHT reference. No reference footage, source cutouts, narration, or approval is distributed.
limitations: New assets and dimensions need fresh visual review; this is a reusable 2D structure, not recovered 3D.
Source-specific image masks were removed. Use a licensed transparent cutout or author a new mask for the new subject.
A contained layout preserves geometry across aspect ratios but may need manual reframing.
Font availability and speech timestamps must be checked locally. No publication approval is included.

requirements.framing: New media stays aspect-correct; intended subject and caption area remain visible.
requirements.typography: Supplied titles and source-aligned words are readable, separate, and preserve emphasis hierarchy.
requirements.motion: Words accumulate at their actual onsets with a brief lift/blur; earlier words retain their row positions.
requirements.rhythm: Holds and reveals follow the new shot and bound speech cues; inspect entrances, exits and cut boundaries.
